Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Predictions continue to underpredict gains on high-performing winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
Sign-in hint (6 wins across 16 tests), home wait_info (4 wins across 12 tests), adoption new_flow (3 wins across 6 tests), and finish new_flow (2 wins across 9 tests) were helpful.
Sign-in reorder changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests.
Choose_path redesign (4 tests) and adoption redesign (3 tests) consistently failed to show positive effects.
Choose_path copy (3 tests), home redesign (2 tests), home new_screen (2 tests), and adoption incentive (2 tests) changes showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories tested only once (e.g., finish copy, finish layout, finish redesign, home new_flow, adoption copy, adoption hint).

            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.

            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Sign-In Account Pet Restoration Safety Banner Hint
candidates.change: Displays a explicit hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that logging in with their existing account will restore missing pets and cloud save progress.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign-in hints have historically produced 6 wins across 16 tests.

sign_in.hint: Signing into your existing account automatically restores all your previously adopted pets and cloud progress.

candidates.title: Interactive Custom Pet Expression Calibration Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive choice card component during custom pet upload allowing users to calibrate their pet's default expression style.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking wrong; adoption sub-flows have proven effective with 3 wins in 6 tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Generation Status Stage Indicator
candidates.change: Enables step counter and progress display on the waiting screen to keep users informed during rendering.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high median wait time of 201s and mean of 2336s; wait_info improvements on the home step have yielded 4 wins across 12 tests.

waiting.hint: Generating desktop pet animations and building asset pack...

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Quick Action Setup Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive action test button on the finish home intro screen so users can try toggling their pet right away.
candidates.why: 3 support emails indicated confusion regarding how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding, and finish sub-flows have 2 wins.

candidates.title: Sign-In Account Recovery Verification Flow
candidates.change: Adds an explicit account recovery button on the sign-in screen for users trying to locate existing pet saves.
candidates.why: Directly targets the 8 support emails concerning lost pets upon re-authenticating.

candidates.title: Desktop Rendering Diagnostic Progress Flow
candidates.change: Adds a status checklist component to the waiting screen verifying display engine initialization.
candidates.why: Address 3 support tickets where pets failed to show on desktop or stalled during onboarding setup.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Photo Subject Framing Hint
candidates.change: Provides clear photo framing advice on the upload screen to guide users towards higher-quality generation inputs.
candidates.why: Addresses support complaints regarding custom pets looking wrong or failing generation.

upload_photos.hint: For optimal results, upload a well-lit photo showing your pet centered with clear contrast.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Quick Overview Screen
candidates.change: Appends a new onboarding screen at the end explaining essential hotkeys and tray icon controls.
candidates.why: 3 support emails showed confusion on controlling/hiding pets and 4 emails reported desktop feature misbehavior after setup.

new_desktop_companion_overview.body: Right-click your pet or use system tray controls anytime to customize actions or hide your companion.
new_desktop_companion_overview.headline: Desktop Companion Controls Overview

candidates.title: Choose Path Instant vs Custom Creation Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint explaining the difference between instant adoption and custom pet photo creation.
candidates.why: Choose path step takes a mean of 514s and experiences dropoff (79.7% conversion). Clarifying choices reduces decision paralysis.

choose_path.hint: Choose Instant Adoption to start right away, or Custom Creation to generate a pet from your photos.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Launch System Tray Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Enables the ready notification toggle and provides tray management hint on the home intro screen.
candidates.why: Helps users locate their companion immediately upon onboarding completion, preventing confusion when opening the app.

home_intro.hint: Your desktop pet is now live in your system tray! Click its icon to view controls.
